steps.title: Gentle Control & Balance from Nanocoil Fibers
firstParagraphs: Our Nanocoil fibers are made in a helicoidal shape that's designed to give controlled cradling support to each sleeper.
These proprietary fibers retain the pillow's shape night after night, so your pillow feels like a dream every time you rest your head on it.
secondParagraphs: Instead of going flat overtime, Nuzzle retains the needed bulk and support for over 1001 nights.
They're designed to balance the softness and support you need when you sleep, continually adapting to the weight of your head and sleep position.

steps.title: Experience Perfect Spinal Alignment In Any Sleep Position
firstParagraphs: No single pillow works best for everyone. That's why Nuzzle's outer shell houses 2 inner layers that can be used separately or together to create your dream pillow.
You can customize the amount of neck support for better spine health and fewer visits to the chiropractor.
secondParagraphs: The soft layer provides support and added softness and plushiness. It's perfect for stomach sleepers to keep your necks totally levelled.
The medium layer is designed to maintain straight spinal alignment from the neck down, and is perfect for back or combination sleepers.
Using both layers provides ultimate firmness and is perfect for keeping neck and spinal alignment for side sleepers.

steps.title: Stay Cool & Comfortable All Night Long
firstParagraphs: The outer shell of the Nuzzle pillow reacts to your body temperature, absorbing heat from you when you're hot, and releasing it back to you as you cool down - keeping you at the optimal temperature of 37.5°C.
secondParagraphs: The phase change technology is micro encapsulated and applied to soft cotton.

Inspired by the fabric developed for NASA space suits, Nuzzle reacts to your temperature, absorbing heat from you when you get warmer, and releasing it back to you as you cool down. So you can chill out all year round.

items.question: Can the Nuzzle pillow be washed and dried?
items.answer: Yes, the Nuzzle pillow is machine washable and dryable. It is recommended to wash it on a gentle cycle and tumble dry on low heat.

items.question: Who Is The Nuzzle Pillow Designed For?
items.answer: Nuzzle is designed for anyone that is looking to sleep their way to a better day. Whether you sleep on your side, back, stomach, or a combination of all three - Nuzzle is designed to provide you with the perfect support for your head and neck.

items.question: Will the Nuzzle pillow lose its shape over time?
items.answer: No, Nuzzle has been lab tested to retain its shape for over 1001 days and nights, even after repeated washing. The Nanocoils provide controlled support to each sleeper, ensuring the pillow maintains its fluff and flex over a long period of time.

items.question: How does the 90 Day Guarantee work?
items.answer: Try it for 90 days entirely at our risk. If you are not absolutely delighted with the Nuzzle pillow from the very first night, simply return it for a full refund. Contact our full-time dedicated support team for assistance, no questions asked.

items.question: How Long Does Shipping Take?
items.answer: All orders will ship within two business days after your order is placed. Orders ship from our warehouse in Los Angeles, CA warehouse with USPS. Transit times typically average 2 - 3 days.

items.question: How can I get a refund?
items.answer: Contact our full-time dedicated support team for assistance. They will be happy to process your refund for you.
